system.description:
Lore: Relic Tome

Written by Auril's own priesthood as a primer on her worship, its silver-gilt pages describe rites better left un-performed.

A thin, cold-to-the-touch tome bound in white ermine over white pine, sealed with a tarnished silver clasp. While it's in your possession, you have Immune: Cold.

A spellcaster who spends a Shift studying the Codicil learns the Frostburn Spell (if they don't already know it). Bound within its pages is also a poem, "Rime of the Frostmaiden" - an incantation whose true power is tied to a specific place and moment (GM's discretion).

It has the following Powers:

  • Auril's Ward: While the book is in your possession you are Immune to Cold.
  • Rites of the Frostmaiden: A Caster who studies it for a Shift adds @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.PHrsI0UrnCxQjjSq]{Freeze} and @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.GvDP0oYm6yPkkb6o]{Frostburn} to the Spells they know.

Value: 800g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
